scriptData.label: @effect.name
Broken Head (Minor)

description.label: Description
description.value:
You barely avoid getting beheaded but your foe’s blade still nicks your trachea and takes a piece out of your Adam’s apple, giving you a small but disturbing extra smile and making amusing whistling noises as air passes in and out through the hole.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (1) and @Condition[Fatigued] (2), the latter of which lasts until you have had Medical Attention to plug the hole. Also, gain @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.nbhn2wX35b7Jrcbg]{Broken Bone (Minor)} as the injury also makes it difficult to talk properly and eating solid food comfortably until healed.
